content: This foam mattress felt comfortable for the first few nights, but it quickly started to sag in the middle. The “cooling” feature is basically nonexistent, and I wake up sweaty even in a well-ventilated room. It has a strong chemical odor that lingered far longer than the advertised off-gassing period. The edges collapse when I sit down, making it hard to get in and out of bed. Despite being labeled “medium firm,” it feels oddly mushy and provides poor back support. Motion transfer is worse than expected, so every time my partner shifts I can feel it. Customer service was unhelpful and kept repeating scripted answers instead of addressing the issue. I regret buying this and wouldn’t recommend it to anyone looking for a durable, supportive mattress.
